articles.summary: Owens Corning (NYSE: OC), a building products leader, today announced that it has entered into an amended agreement to sell its glass reinforcements business to Praana Group, accelerating cash realization and updating the terms of the previously announced sale. The amended agreement eliminates seller notes and increases up-front cash proceeds, streamlining Owens Corning’s separation from the business. The agreement also adjusts the total enterprise value of the sale from $755 million to $645 million. The adjusted transaction value reflects changing market conditions impacting the business while maintaining a consistent valuation multiple. This sale is part of Owens Corning’s strategy to strengthen its focus as a building products leader in North America and Europe and exit high capital-intensive businesses. articles.title: Owens Corning Enters Into Amended Agreement with Praana Group for Sale of Glass Reinforcements Business
